question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "deposited."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• "Deposited" means to put something down somewhere. (किसी निर्धारित स्‍थान पर कुछ रखना)
 
• In this sentence, **"deposited"** is used to convey the idea that individuals placed their gold in the bank, and in return, the bank issued notes that represented the value of the deposited gold.
 
• **"Deposited" **here indicates a formal act of putting money or assets into the bank for safekeeping or exchange.
 
• Hence, the answer is option 3.
 
• Correct paragraph:

........Because they could only be used by the person whose name was on them, these were not only lightweight but also deterred robberies. In accordance with this concept, banks later issued notes in exchange for **deposited**__ gold that could be used as cash.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Contained: **to have something inside or as part of itself. (अपने अंदर कुछ होना या अपना अंग होना; समावेशित होना)
 
• **Collected: **to bring a number of things together. (विभिन्‍न वस्‍तुओं को एकत्र करना, इकट्ठा करना)
 
• **Settled: **to put an end to an argument or disagreement. (बहस या विवाद को सुलझा लेना)
